title: Gold price update today, June 28, 2026: Price of 9999 gold, plain rings BTMC DOJI Phu Quy Sunday
snippet: June 28, 2026, gold prices closed the week with a slight decrease in gold bars, while gold rings surpassed 148 million VND/ounce. World gold prices remained
extractedText: Today, June 28, 2026, gold prices saw a drop of up to 1.6 million VND per tael for gold bars, a decrease of nearly a week. Today, June 28, 2026, gold prices at many businesses saw a slight decrease compared to the beginning of last week. Among the surveyed group, DOJI experienced the sharpest decline, with both buying and selling prices falling by 1.6 million VND/ounce compared to June 22nd. At SJC Company, the price of gold today, June 28, 2026, closed at 144.5 million VND/ounce for buying and 148.5 million VND/ounce for selling. Compared to June 22, when SJC gold bars traded at 145.6 - 148.6 million VND/ounce, the buying price is now down 1.1 million VND/ounce, while the selling price is 100,000 VND/ounce lower. At DOJI, the price of gold bars today, June 28, 2026, remains at 144.0 million VND/ounce for buying and 147.0 million VND/ounce for selling. Earlier last week, the company set the price of gold bars at 145.6 - 148.6 million VND/ounce. Thus, the buying price at DOJI has decreased by 1.6 million VND/ounce, and the selling price is also 1.6 million VND/ounce lower than on June 22nd. At Bao Tin Minh Chau, the price of gold today, June 28, 2026, is recorded at 144.3 million VND/ounce for buying and 148.5 million VND/ounce for selling. Compared to the 145.6 - 148.6 million VND/ounce mark on June 22, the buying price is currently down by 1.3 million VND/ounce, while the selling price is 100,000 VND/ounce lower. In Phu Quy, the price of gold bars today, June 28, 2026, is fixed at 145.3 million VND/ounce for buying and 148.5 million VND/ounce for selling. Compared to the beginning of last week, when this brand traded at 145.5 - 148.5 million VND/ounce, the buying price decreased by 200,000 VND/ounce, while the selling price remained unchanged. According to PNJ, the price of gold today, June 28, 2026, is trading at 145.5 million VND/ounce for buying and 148.5 million VND/ounce for selling. On June 22, gold bars at PNJ closed at 145.6 - 148.6 million VND/ounce. Thus, the buying price is currently 100,000 VND/ounce lower, while the selling price has decreased by 100,000 VND/ounce.
author: Báo Lâm Đồng
